complementarity: h16 capped nonlinear-axis support identifies the five CR3 planes missed by h04 UX-Hessian profile JD, while being exactly flat in alpha-gamma where JD is informative. C1-C3 support is zero, and JD identifies all axes. Saturation prevents reducing large genuine nonlinearities from compensating for loss of linear axes, unlike previous amplitude sums.
weight_rule: Same coefficient for all models: twice the sufficient lower bound derived from every single-loss plane outside six degrees, rounded to 9. For self the lower bound is 4.3416587580; for modulation it is 71.8641001789. No finite upper constraint because the complementary alpha-gamma support curve is flat. Require new full-dimensional G1 and then identical-inference G2 before G3.
scope: Only Hessian RMS self curvature or Hessian modulation support plus Hessian profile JD; no parameter labels or model-specific operators
